newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Amity Oil to get offshore Australia permit.
newsitem.headline: Amity Oil to get offshore Australia permit.

text.p: Australian oil explorer Amity Oil NL said on Tuesday it had been offered and intended to accept 100 percent of Gippsland Basin Permit V96-G1 offshore southern Victoria.
Area V96-G1 lies between the Lakes Entrance oilfield to the north and the Sunfish oilfield and North Turrum and Marlin oil and gas fields to the south, Amity said.
Most of the area of V96-G1 had been only lightly explored and significant potential for economic petroleum deposits remains, it said.
Amity said it had committed to seismic reprocessing and 560 km of new seismic work in the first three years of the permit.
Amity will accept the offer, by the Designated Authority in Victoria acting for the Federal-Victoria Offshore Petroleum Joint Authority, so that grant of the permit can proceed, it said.
